## Purpose

Describe the rule, bug, experiment, or documentation change and why it is needed.

## Evidence and tests

- [ ] I ran the applicable offline checks in `CONTRIBUTING.md` (or explain what I could not run).
- [ ] I compared generated results and documented any changed expected outcomes.
- [ ] Any new security case was specified before its implementation and remains `proposed` pending owner review.

Commands run and results:

## Scope and disclosure

- [ ] The change uses only synthetic fixtures and contains no secrets, real target data, or private network addresses.
- [ ] The documentation still distinguishes modeled decisions/effects from real enforcement and deployment measurements.

For a vulnerability report, follow `SECURITY.md` and do not disclose exploit details in a public PR.
